subject.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel

question: Should Android Settings expose Skill Workshop apply, reject, and quarantine actions once the current-head i18n and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR reuses existing operator.admin Gateway methods, but it expands privileged proposal lifecycle control onto Android and that product/security-boundary choice should not be inferred by automation.

options.title: Ship gated mobile lifecycle actions
options.body: After i18n/formatting and current-head proof are refreshed, Android ships apply/reject/quarantine behind the existing operator.admin scope gate.

options.title: Ship read-only Android review first
options.body: Keep list/detail/filter parity on Android but defer mutation actions until mobile privileged-action UX receives separate approval.

options.title: Pause the Android Skill Workshop panel
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want Skill Workshop proposal review in the Android Settings surface yet.

recommendation.title: Ship gated mobile lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: After i18n/formatting and current-head proof are refreshed, Android ships apply/reject/quarantine behind the existing operator.admin scope gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assigned reviewer on the live PR and can route the Android/product-security decision to the right owner if needed.
